notes: The 1978 volume of the Recreation and Park Commission. Curated: architects' agreements, dedications of rebuilt playgrounds, and the December renamings for George Moscone and Harvey Milk.

coverage.remaining: Routine items not curated. Not placed: the Panhandle playground rededication (Nov 14; no place page), the Knudsen-Bloom property design (Esherick Hornsey Dodge and Davis; no page), the Marina Green running trail by Donald MacDonald (Feb 16), Wolf Woods at the zoo.
coverage.note: Dated by footers. Curated list F1978.py.

findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved a $6,000 agreement with Richard Schadt Associates, landscape architects, to design a play structure and site improvements for Excelsior Playground at Russia Avenue and Madrid Street.

findings.address_as_written: Mary B. Connolly Childrens' Playground re-dedication
findings.description: Mayor George R. Moscone was to rededicate the rebuilt Children's Playground as the Mary B. Connolly Children's Playground on March 22, with Mr. and Mrs. Walter A. Haas and Mr. and Mrs. Walter Shorenstein, whose gifts began the project, and to unveil a granite marker calling it the oldest public playground in the United States; it had reopened in December.
